preregistered_predictions: ISLA with measure weights (constant or similarity gauge): |D_area| <= 3% at all n on both datasets.
ISLA constant gauge fails D_biased (known 12x at 10k) but passes D_area.
GeoTransolver and Transolver (no measure): |D_area| >= 10% on HiLift (heterogeneous multi-element meshes), smaller on DrivAerML; D_biased >= 200% (known 9.5x / 3.9x).
ISLA weights-off ablation: fails D_area on HiLift.
notes: Frame convention: the bench pipeline centres (CenterMesh) on the 320,000-cell reader pool BEFORE the samplers, so the area/biased factors for the measure-weighted (mw_*) arms are pool-frame values, exactly like the unweighted baselines and the ISLA arms in consistency_bench_2026-09-10.json.

mw_* arms: snapshot code_mw, model yamls geotransolver_surface_mw / transolver_surface_mw (copied from recipe_mw/conf/model into recipe_bench/conf/model), forward_kwargs.measure_weights=interior.point_data._target_quadrature_measure, model.measure_weighted_slices=true, unit drive; HiLift arms have three seeds (42,43,44).
